title: tenant-scoped-upgrade-preflight-with-traffic-replay-and-terraform-plan-harness
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Problem: Private (VPC) customers run upgrades to the data-plane/runtime that occasionally cause tenant-visible regressions due to subtle config drift, tenant-specific networking, or model priming differences. Current rollout automation lacks a tenant-scoped preflight that combines IaC plan validation with a realistic traffic replay to catch regressions before traffic shift.

Goal: Build a zero-downtime preflight harness that: (1) generates a tenant-scoped Terraform plan diff against the target runtime configuration, (2) performs a dry-run deployment in a shadow slice using the customer's own cached KV/prefix (where allowed), and (3) replays sampled production traffic (synthetic and recorded) into the shadow slice to exercise priming, batch behavior, and health probes. The harness should produce an automated pass/fail signal and human-readable findings for the rollout controller to gate canary/traffic expansion.

Scope: private (VPC) data-plane runtime rollouts only. This ticket covers the preflight harness, Terraform plan integration, and the health-gate signal; separate followups will integrate this into the final rollout sequencer and RBACed operator UI.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Given a tenant + proposed runtime config, the system can produce a tenant-scoped Terraform plan diff URL and a normalized summary (three-line drift summary).
2) The harness can create a short-lived shadow slice in the tenant's VPC (or sandbox overlay) and deploy the candidate runtime without changing live routing.
3) The harness replays a 15-minute sample of production production-like traffic (or synthetic equivalent) and records latency percentile deltas, error spike events, KV cache miss rate, and token-rate throughput.
4) The automated verdict (PASS|WARN|FAIL) is produced within 30 minutes for typical tenant slices, and includes actionable remediation suggestions.
5) Harness artifacts include a GitHub PR link (if IaC changes), console dashboard link, and an exported JSON findings file attached to the Linear ticket.
implementation_notes:
High-level design: (A) Terraform plan generator component will use our private-terraform-modules repo and run 'terraform plan -out' against a per-tenant state snapshot (s3 backend stub) to compute diffs; output sanitized to remove secrets. (B) Shadow slice creation uses existing slice-provisioner, extended to accept 'ephemeral' lifecycle and to mount tenant KV snapshot. (C) Traffic replay engine will be an adapter around our existing request-sampler that supports payload transformation and rate shaping to avoid DoS. (D) Health gates computed by a rules engine (latency delta thresholds, 5xx spike detection, kv-miss regression >5%) and returned as structured verdict.

Trade-offs considered: We could do a pure config-only preflight (simpler) but that misses runtime behaviors like batch/kv priming. Full tenant-mirroring is costly; opted for ephemeral slices with sampled traffic to balance cost and signal. Persistent cache mounting requires customer consent; default is synthetic priming when mounting not permitted.

Security & compliance: terraform plans are sanitized before storage; plan artifacts are stored in an encrypted S3 path and access-limited. Security review required before GA.

Related artifacts: Confluence spec: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INF/tenant-preflight-replay-spec, Proposed PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/private-terraform-modules/pull/287
test_plan:
- Unit tests for Terraform plan sanitizer (edge cases: provider creds masked, large diffs).
- Integration test: create ephemeral shadow slice in dev VPC, deploy runtime image X, run synthetic replay, assert health gates evaluate PASS under controlled load.
- Failure injection: introduce a deliberate env var mismatch and ensure harness flags FAIL and includes helpful remediation.
- Load test: run harness end-to-end for 10 tenants in parallel and measure time-to-verdict and infra cost.
- E2E staging run against a consenting customer: coordinate with Solutions Eng to run on a single tenant snapshot and collect feedback.
rollback_playbook: If harness verdict is FAIL or WARN during canary: 1) Abort traffic expansion immediately. 2) Mark release as blocked in release tracker and signal on-call (runtime-team). 3) Optionally revert IaC via the 'apply-revert' job that runs 'terraform apply' on the prior state; this is gated and requires operator approval for private deployments. 4) If a hotfix is available, schedule a fast patch rollout to shadow slice and re-run harness. 5) Postmortem: collect harness artifacts, console traces, and tenant logs and tag incident 'upgrade-preflight-fail'.
